diagram_math_checks.result: The six objects are M(lambda), M(s dot lambda), M(t dot lambda), M(st dot lambda), M(ts dot lambda), M(w0 dot lambda), for s=s_alpha1, t=s_alpha2, w0=sts=tst. They match step 1.1. Independently computed the shifted Dynkin coordinate reflections s(a,b)=(-a,a+b), t(a,b)=(a+b,-b): all six lambda-w dot lambda displacements equal the source list (0,0),(p,0),(0,q),(p+q,q),(p,p+q),(p+q,p+q). Positivity of p,q makes them distinct.

Independently applied the supplier rank-inequality definition to the six permutations in S3 (e=(0,1,2), s=(1,0,2), t=(0,2,1), products by composition) and inversion lengths. Exactly eight covers result: e<s,e<t,s<st,s<ts,t<st,t<ts,st<w0,ts<w0. They match the eight source covers in steps 2.1-2.2.

Each displayed arrow reverses its Bruhat cover: M(w0 dot lambda) to M(st dot lambda) and M(ts dot lambda); each of M(st dot lambda), M(ts dot lambda) to each of M(s dot lambda), M(t dot lambda); M(s dot lambda) and M(t dot lambda) to M(lambda). These are precisely the six simple-root embeddings of step 2.1 plus the two nonsimple-root embeddings of step 2.2. Step 3.1 supplies all longer composites and the converse. No extra edge or comparability is drawn.

The middle diagonals cross without a vertex, explicitly stated in the caption; the two length-one and two length-two modules remain incomparable. Only existence and orientation of embeddings are asserted; no normalization or commutativity of chosen maps is claimed. The rigorous Verification is unchanged and independent of the figure.
